Name: Cuter Fatter Sheep
Author: Identitypollution
Description:
03/09/19 UPDATE! Now includes baby sheep as well thanks to BeneathThePlass for editing those! They are now included in the file and I've also changed the file to a zip instead of a rar since some people had trouble opening that file type. 

To Install:
1. OPTIONAL (but suggested just incase): Backup your Sheared Sheep.xnb and Sheep.xnb files located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract download.
3. Put the new .xnb files where your old ones were (at the location above). Make sure to REPLACE the files or your game won't know what to use and won't start.
4. Done! Launch the game and enjoy adorably fat Baa-Baas~!
